title: Further restriction between ringed slices is exact
statement: Let (C,J) be a small site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], R a sheaf of rings and f:X→Y a morphism. Further restriction from R|Y-module sheaves on C/Y to R|X-module sheaves on C/X [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-pur-localized-ringed-site] preserves finite limits and finite colimits.

source.place: Tag 093U, lemma-kernel-finite-locally-constant (3), further restriction between ringed slices is exact

proof.text: The functor C/X→C/Y induced by f is continuous and cocontinuous for the slice topologies. Restriction of abelian sheaves along it is thus a right adjoint and also a left adjoint. Both adjunctions exist on the small slice sites, so it preserves finite limits and colimits.

Further module restriction commutes with the underlying-abelian-sheaf functor. Module sheafification gives finite-limit and finite-colimit preservation by this faithful functor. Reflect short exactness to deduce preservation of short exact sequences under further module restriction.
Apply the additive exact-functor criterion to obtain preservation of finite limits and colimits.
